copilotClient.checkStatus: VSCodium Copilot Client: Check API status
copilotClient.refreshQuota: VSCodium Copilot Client: Refresh remaining quota
config.statusBarDisplay: What the status bar shows next to the Copilot icon: percent remaining, or the remaining/total amount.
config.model: Engine model id used for completions. Empty = first completion model from the API.
config.prefixTokens: Approximate token budget for the prefix (text before cursor).
config.suffixTokens: Approximate token budget for the suffix (text after cursor).
config.maxTokens: Maximum number of tokens the model may generate.
config.cliMcp.enabled: Expose an MCP server for the terminal Copilot CLI, advertised via ~/.copilot/ide lock files.
